entries.name: Chargement d'entraînement de Tank
entries.sourceWork: The Matrix (1999), Tank as living Nebuchadnezzar operator
entries.appearance: Adult shipboard operator with medium-brown skin and short dark hair, worn earth-toned knit sweater, work trousers and boots, simple communication earpiece/headset, no black Matrix trenchcoat, no Agent sunglasses and no implanted headjack. A small physical shipboard console/keyboard is his support instrument, not a magical floating screen.
entries.weapon: Compact physical operator keyboard/terminal and headset; no firearm or projected combat avatar
entries.pose: Read the selected physical console, type a command or use headset, then acknowledge; no offensive energy or gunshot.
entries.notes: Real operator role from1999; game support is a bounded crossover abstraction, no body projected inside the Matrix.
